'''Hangar bay H-12''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] aboard the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Subjugator (Victory-class)|''Subjugator'']]. The hangar was site of a battle between [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kolaff]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents who fought in [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]].
